RAS_FOR_STS2_RELIC_XILA_STARTER_RELIC.de: The first time you play a Queen Weapon card each combat, restore {Energy:energyIcons()} Energy. At the start of combat, gain {Guard} [gold]Guard[/gold].
RAS_FOR_STS2_RELIC_XILA_STARTER_RELIC.fl: She's always carried it, even though it's heavier than she is.
RAS_FOR_STS2_RELIC_TOPAZ_AMULET.title: Topaz Amulet
RAS_FOR_STS2_RELIC_TOPAZ_AMULET.descript: At the end of combat, if you took no damage, your card rewards include an additional card. Also drop [gold]{Gold}[/gold] additional gold.
RAS_FOR_STS2_RELIC_TOPAZ_AMULET.flavor: Legend says topaz reflects the bearer's resilience; only the unscathed earn its gifts.
RAS_FOR_STS2_RELIC_RED_BOOKLET.title: Red Booklet
RAS_FOR_STS2_RELIC_RED_BOOKLET.descripti: When your HP would drop to 0 or below, heal [blue]{Heal}%[/blue] of your max HP and gain [gold]{Gold}[/gold] gold. (Can only trigger once.)
RAS_FOR_STS2_RELIC_RED_BOOKLET.flavor: The bloodstained booklet holds an ancient pact: gold as ransom, life as price.
RAS_FOR_STS2_RELIC_MOUNTAIN_STAFF.title: Mountain Staff
RAS_FOR_STS2_RELIC_MOUNTAIN_STAFF.descri: When your Queen Weapon is the Moonlight Greatsword, attack cards you play deal an additional 75% damage, but enemy attacks also deal an additional 75% damage to you.
RAS_FOR_STS2_RELIC_MOUNTAIN_STAFF.flavor: The ancient staff draws power from the earth, sharpening the Moonlight Greatsword's edge.
RAS_FOR_STS2_RELIC_TRICKERY_BOOK.title: Trickery Book
RAS_FOR_STS2_RELIC_TRICKERY_BOOK.descrip: When you generate a card, apply 1 Doom and 1 Poison to all enemies.
RAS_FOR_STS2_RELIC_TRICKERY_BOOK.flavor: Within its treacherous pages, every chapter hides a deadly trap.
RAS_FOR_STS2_RELIC_STONE_DRAGON_ARMOR.de: When your Guard stacks are depleted, gain [blue]{Guard}[/blue] Guard at the start of next turn.
RAS_FOR_STS2_RELIC_STONE_DRAGON_ARMOR.fl: Woven from stone dragon scales, even shattered, it reforms at dawn.
RAS_FOR_STS2_RELIC_BEAT_BOOTS.title: Beat Boots
RAS_FOR_STS2_RELIC_BEAT_BOOTS.descriptio: The first time you switch Queen Weapon each combat, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card(s) and gain [blue]{Guard}[/blue] Guard.
RAS_FOR_STS2_RELIC_BEAT_BOOTS.flavor: Treading to an ancient rhythm, every switch is perfectly timed.
RAS_FOR_STS2_RELIC_RAINBOW_CLOAK.title: Rainbow Cloak
RAS_FOR_STS2_RELIC_RAINBOW_CLOAK.descrip: Choose a relic you own, and gain another copy of it.
RAS_FOR_STS2_RELIC_RAINBOW_CLOAK.flavor: The iridescent cloak reflects all you have gathered, granting the power to relive them.
